referenceFunction.generalComment: The dataset is taken from the LCA study of typical inkjet cartridges; UUID: cadf25a9-db59-32dc-8c63-02c204b22baf
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset for inkjet cartridge is built fromfrom the detailed LCA study of Krystofik et al., 2014, in which the authors break down the assembly of cartridge components at the material level. The cartridge assembly is categorized into several subparts, namely housing, circuitry/flexible printed circuit board, cartridge label, ink/solvent-based ink, and other materials. The production is assumed to occur globally as the production origin of each material/component location could not be identified as described in the original study.
